findings_summary: All three legacy publication heads remain valid research evidence, but they do not encode one successor target. TP2-DE338F269CA11E9BC01B terminates the q=3r-1 arithmetic-core task by exact reduction to fixed kernel R_m(q); TP2-D78DBA0243911E0363FA is the bounded forced-midpoint fallback route; TP2-2346F5D3E731ED56DB0A targets a separate composite equal-depth p-adic mechanism. The fixed-kernel residue is not the hard target of TP2-2346F5D3E731ED56DB0A.
